title: About Alexander Colón | Wichita Area Real Estate Agent
description: How Alex works, who he works with, and what he will not do. Read it and decide whether he is a fit before you spend a phone call finding out.
h1: How Alex works, and who he is a poor fit for
job: Let a visitor decide whether this is the right person, on purpose, before they call.
primaryPrinciple: Trust is a person. The soft ask, after the visitor has enough to judge.

bands.headline: How Alex works, and who he is a poor fit for
bands.support: Most agent pages are a list of adjectives. This one is about the actual working relationship, including the parts that would make you choose somebody else.

bands.heading: Who he is a poor fit for
body: If you want an agent who will agree with your price, tell you the house is perfect, and match your enthusiasm at every step, he is going to disappoint you. He will tell you when a house has a problem and when a number is wrong, and some people find that deflating rather than useful.

If you want to be pushed, he will not do that either. He works with people who are a year out from doing anything and he does not chase them in between. If you need someone to create urgency for you, that is a real preference and he is not the one.
